notes: Production source uses retain/replace/move/retire lifecycle actions, never the behavior-oriented A/B/C/D/E test taxonomy.
Every source row is proposed. Mixed and uncertain path-based classifications require human review before approval.
Run bun contracts/v1/generate-production-source-dispositions.ts --check to validate schema, provenance, joins, and exact 190-subject parity.

description: Owns frozen-source classification and approval evidence, but no production engine edits.
Owns the reusable selector evaluator and its private host boundary.
Owns the v1 StoreTree kernel, graph, lifecycle, scopes, and transactions.
Owns current ShiftX migration and packed-artifact evidence without editing the kernel.
Owns preserved ESM, adapter boundaries, and optional-package extraction.

title: Synchronous stable core
rationale: The stable Store and State contract is synchronous.

title: One selector evaluator
rationale: Committed, scratch, and hydration hosts share one evaluator implementation.

title: One mutation kernel
rationale: Direct writes and transactions use one draft, preflight, apply, propagation, and notification path.

title: One StoreTree transaction
rationale: Transactions are synchronous, flat, and limited to one StoreTree.

title: Primitive scope ownership
rationale: Scopes use parent-local identity, explicit ownership, and deterministic disposal.

title: Isolated runtime domains
rationale: Nominal handles reject mixed runtime ownership before work without global adoption.

title: Identity-only family
rationale: Stable family is an identity combinator without hidden Store membership.

title: Collection-owned membership
rationale: Rows, membership, structural indexes, and exact queries belong to collection boundaries.

title: Cache companion extraction
rationale: Loader, stale, max-age, and SWR policy leave the stable State and Store internals.

title: Inspection companion extraction
rationale: Snapshots, change streams, and tooling observation do not branch the ordinary Store runtime.

title: Schema companion extraction
rationale: Validation and codecs are optional boundaries rather than constructor semantics in the stable core.

title: Explicit artifact boundary
rationale: Transfer and persistence use explicit artifacts instead of Store hydration or ambient registries.

title: Remove writable globals
rationale: Writable cross-StoreTree globals and process-wide Store registries are removed.

title: Remove async State settlement
rationale: Promise values, late dependencies, and async selector settlement are outside the stable State contract.

title: Narrow adapter boundary
rationale: Adapters consume a versioned capability boundary and do not receive manual core lifecycle machinery.

title: Preserved package boundaries
rationale: Stable, optional, and private code remain independently reachable from packed preserved ESM entrypoints.

title: Remove legacy graph modes
rationale: Fixed points, cold validation, twin evaluators, and orphan sidecars are not ported.

title: Application-owned initialization
rationale: Initialization happens in explicit owner code, not Provider render or an implicit Store interpreter.
